decision.explanation: The two provided documents present conflicting claims about the same individual, Pierre-Paul Boësnier de l'Orme. Document D1 (South Australian context) states he is a Member of the South Australian House of Assembly, while Document D2 (French context) describes him as Vice President. These are distinct roles in different jurisdictions and cannot be reconciled as referring to the same office. Since both are directly supported by their respective sources and there is no explicit contradiction between the roles themselves (only ambiguity about whether they apply to the same person), both are retained as valid answers under separate referents.
